name: pci-dss-mcp
description: PCI DSS v4.0.1 compliance scanner for Go payment services, delivered as an MCP server. Every finding maps to a specific PCI DSS requirement ID. Taint-aware cardholder data flow analysis with PCI SSC FAQ semantics, designed to complement broad SAST tools like Semgrep and CodeQL - not replace them.
